label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 234 ]

blocks.text: The post-cold war world is a very different place. Power is moving from
Western countries to other areas of the world. Global politics, as a result, has
become more complex, involving countries from many civilizations. In this new
world, both differences and similarities in culture determine partners and
enemies. These factors have caused political and economic differences among
countries. Moreover, these differences often cause local conflicts to grow into

readingSentences.english: The post-cold war world is a very different place.
readingSentences.korean: 냉전 후 세계는 아주 다른 곳이다.

readingSentences.english: Power is moving from Western countries to other areas of the world.
readingSentences.korean: 힘이 서양 국가들로부터 세계의 다른 지역들로 이동하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: Global politics, as a result, has become more complex, involving countries from many civilizations.
readingSentences.korean: 그래서, 국제 정치는 보다 복잡해져서, 많은 문명권들을 포함하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: In this new world, both differences and similarities in culture determine partners and enemies.
readingSentences.korean: 이런 새로운 세계에서, 문화에 있어 차이점들과 유사성들이 종지와 적을 결정한다.

readingSentences.english: These factors have caused political and economic differences among countries.
readingSentences.korean: 이런 요인들이 국가들 간의 정치적 경제적 차이들을 야기시킨다.

readingSentences.english: Moreover, these differences often cause local conflicts to grow into larger wars.
readingSentences.korean: 게다가, 이러한 차이들은 종종 지역적 분쟁들이 커져서 보다 큰 전쟁이 되게 한다.

readingSentences.english: Thus, the most important issue facing these countries is understanding the difference among cultures.
readingSentences.korean: 따라서, 이러한 나라들이 직면한 가장 중요한 문제는 문화간의 차이들을 이해하는 것이다.
